blind.description: A stylised pair of short, stacked-stone pillar posts capped with flat square stone slabs, connected at the base by a low stone threshold or curb. The stones are chunky and grey with painted mossy green patches on the top capstones and near the joints. The structure is fully solid and sits directly flat on the ground without an added plinth or baseplate.
blind.from_above: Two square post tops with green moss highlights flanking a narrower rectangular stone threshold connecting them, forming a wide 'H' or dumbbell-like footprint.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.8 to 3 ft tall), with a total width slightly greater than its height (about 3.5 to 4 ft wide).
